request.text: Seamless warm bowed-glass resonance on A3 E4, broad velvety overtones breathing in very slow gentle swells. Spacious, nourishing, meditative, rich but transparent. No melodic sequence, beat, pulsing bass, ticking or dramatic rise. Soft upper frequencies, no beginning or ending. No voices, harsh transients or distortion. Quiet microscopic pond-game sound design.
